courses.title: Social Work and Public Safety
courses.description: Restricted to social work majors and pre-majors. Focuses on the intersection between social work, public safety, law, and human services. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Offered on the letter-grade basis only.

courses.subject: PSF
courses.title: Public Safety Field Immersion
courses.description: Restricted to social work majors and pre-majors. Explores the intersection of social work and public safety. Experiential learning in approved public safety-related settings and a weekly one-hour seminar. One lecture hour a week and completion of 120 hours of service learning for one semester. Offered on the pass/fail basis only.
